title: "What's new in Svelte" June newsletter
body:
### New blog post!

Ready to review. This month, I'm trying to avoid the highlighting the plethora of "starters". There were a lot of routers posted this month, so they make an appearance in the showcase.

Thoughts on whether or not to link to some of the ongoing tutorial series? I've highlighted them a few times in the past but I'm nervous about featuring the same 3-4 content creators every month.

template.text:
### Before submitting the PR, please make sure you do the following
- [ ] It's really useful if your PR references an issue where it is discussed ahead of time. In many cases, features are absent for a reason. For large changes, please create an RFC: https://github.com/sveltejs/rfcs
- [ ] This message body should clearly illustrate what problems it solves.
- [ ] Ideally, include a test that fails without this PR but passes with it.

### Tests
-  [ ] Run the tests with `npm test` and lint the project with `npm run lint`
